subject: prd/feature-implementation-drive
statement: When an implementation or repair task becomes proposal-ready, the feature drive shall present a distinct proposal for operator review and landing into the feature branch through the selected code host's review route.
rationale: Keep task review and integration separate from implementation authority.
fit_criterion: Hosted mode retains authenticated human review and human merge with all existing required checks. Explicit local-git mode requires a complete satisfied ReviewGate for the current task, proposal generation, head, and feature base; an operator-declared once-only receipt binds that aggregate's retained origin ref, object id, and digest. Only the separate operator route may land; it atomically publishes the reviewed task tree at the leased feature base, final proposal/evidence/archive state, and real leased proposal-branch deletion. No task or dependent advances until the retained proof and landed revision are verified on the freshly fetched feature branch. Local output discloses unauthenticated actor and shared-account limits.
